title: DTU Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for Data Scientist Posts
description: The Delhi Technological University (DTU) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancy for 01 Data Scientist post. Interested and eligibile candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their M.E./M. Tech, Ph.D. in Computer Science Engineering can apply for the DTU Notification 2026. Interested applicants can apply in offline mode. Here we have mentioned the education details, age limit, selection...
